description: This file is the entry point for a React-based web application. It imports React, ReactDOM, styles, and the main App component, then renders the App component into the DOM element with id 'root' within a React.StrictMode boundary.

methods.name: ReactDOM.createRoot
methods.description: Creates a root for rendering React components into the specified DOM element.

methods.name: root.render
methods.description: Renders the React component tree into the root container.
